verdict.rationale: Stable documents AI-generated summaries of scanned mail contents. These appear on the product page and pricing plans and as a `summary` field on the MailItem scan details, which gives users AI-derived insight from their mail data inside the product. Its 'AI-powered inbox' auto-sorts and routes mail, but that is automation rather than insights or suggestions surfaced to the user, and there is no evidence of AI recommendations or analysis beyond per-document summaries. missing for 10: AI-generated suggestions or recommended actions, insights across the mailbox beyond single-document summaries, independent or hands-on corroboration of summary quality.
